items_flat.title_en: Over 1,200 AI Lab Staff Petition U.S. Government to Support Tools for Deliberately Pacing Frontier AI
items_flat.title_zh: 超過1,200名AI實驗室員工聯署請願，呼籲美國政府支持「刻意調節前沿AI」工具
items_flat.summary_en: More than 1,200 researchers and staff from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta and other labs signed the “Pacing the Frontier” petition. It asks the U.S. government to support an international effort to develop technical and governance tools that would allow deliberately pacing the frontier of automated AI development. OpenAI and Anthropic publicly endorsed the statement.
items_flat.summary_zh: 超過1,200名來自OpenAI、Anthropic、Google、Meta等實驗室的研究人員與員工簽署「Pacing the Frontier」請願書，呼籲美國政府支持國際合作，開發能刻意調節自動化AI發展前沿的技術與治理工具。OpenAI與Anthropic已公開表態支持。
items_flat.analysis_en: Cross-lab consensus on optional pacing mechanisms rather than an immediate pause is rare. Whether governments build usable tools, and how competitive pressures shape any future voluntary adoption, remains the central uncertainty.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 跨實驗室對「可選的節奏調節工具」而非立即暫停達成共識相當罕見。政府是否真正建立可用機制，以及競爭壓力如何影響未來自願採用，仍是關鍵不確定性。
items_flat.quote: We request that the U.S. government support an international effort to develop the technical and governance tools needed to deliberately pace the frontier of automated AI development.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們請求美國政府支持一項國際努力，開發必要的技術與治理工具，以便刻意調節自動化AI發展的前沿。

items_flat.title_en: xAI Introduces Build Mode for Creating Apps, Games and Dashboards with Grok
items_flat.title_zh: xAI推出Build Mode，讓Grok即時打造App、遊戲與儀表板
items_flat.summary_en: xAI announced Build Mode, now in early beta for SuperGrok Heavy subscribers on web, iOS and Android. Users describe an idea and Grok builds a working website, app, game or interactive dashboard live in the chat, then publishes it to a shareable link.
items_flat.summary_zh: xAI宣布Build Mode進入早期測試，僅限SuperGrok Heavy訂閱者在網頁、iOS與Android使用。使用者描述想法後，Grok會在聊天中即時打造可運作的網站、App、遊戲或互動儀表板，並可發布成可分享連結。
items_flat.analysis_en: This further collapses the distance between idea and functional software inside Grok’s ecosystem. Production robustness, long-term maintainability and real multi-user scale remain to be proven.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這進一步縮短從想法到可運作軟體的距離，並將整個創作循環留在Grok生態系內。實際生產穩定性、長期維護與多用戶規模仍有待驗證。
items_flat.quote: Today we're introducing Build Mode, a new way to create with Grok. Tell Grok an idea, and it builds a working version live in your chat... When it's ready, publish it to a link anyone can open.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們推出Build Mode，一種用Grok創作的新方式。告訴Grok一個想法，它就會在聊天中即時打造可運作的版本……準備好後，可發布成任何人都能開啟的連結。

items_flat.title_en: NVIDIA-Led Open Secure AI Alliance Expands with 60 Partners Including xAI, Microsoft and Hugging Face
items_flat.title_zh: NVIDIA主導的Open Secure AI聯盟擴至60家夥伴，涵蓋xAI、Microsoft與Hugging Face
items_flat.summary_en: NVIDIA’s Open Secure AI Alliance, launched 27 July and further promoted on 28 July, brings together around 60 organizations (including SpaceXAI/xAI, Microsoft, Hugging Face, Mistral, IBM, Linux Foundation and others) to develop open tools and techniques that keep software and agents secure.
items_flat.summary_zh: NVIDIA於7月27日啟動、28日持續推廣的Open Secure AI聯盟，已匯集約60家組織（含SpaceXAI/xAI、Microsoft、Hugging Face、Mistral、IBM、Linux Foundation等），共同開發開放工具與技術，以保障軟體與AI代理的安全。
items_flat.analysis_en: The alliance frames open models and tooling as defensive assets after recent closed-model sandbox incidents. Long-term impact hinges on concrete shared artifacts and whether major closed-model labs eventually join.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 聯盟將開放模型與工具定位為近期封閉模型沙箱事件後的防禦資產。長期成效取決於實際共享產出，以及主要封閉模型實驗室是否最終加入。
items_flat.quote: NVIDIA is contributing open models, model weights, data and new agent harness research to the Open Secure AI Alliance to speed the development of new cybersecurity tools and techniques.
items_flat.quote_zh: NVIDIA將向Open Secure AI聯盟貢獻開放模型、權重、資料與新的代理框架研究，以加速新型網路安全工具與技術的開發。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic’s Claude Mythos Preview Discovers Cryptographic Weaknesses in HAWK and Reduced-Round AES
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic的Claude Mythos Preview發現HAWK與簡化AES的密碼弱點
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic’s Frontier Red Team reported that Claude Mythos Preview found an improved key-recovery attack on HAWK (a NIST post-quantum signature candidate), cutting effective key strength roughly in half (e.g., HAWK-256 from 2^64 to 2^38), and also identified a new attack on reduced-round AES. Full technical papers were released.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic前沿紅隊報告指出，Claude Mythos Preview對HAWK（NIST後量子簽名候選）發現改進的金鑰恢復攻擊，將有效金鑰強度約減半（例如HAWK-256從2^64降至2^38），並對簡化輪數的AES發現新攻擊。完整技術論文已公開。
items_flat.analysis_en: The results show frontier models can already perform expert-level cryptanalysis previously requiring specialists and years of review. They strengthen the case for systematic AI-assisted security evaluation of cryptographic standards, while remaining non-practical against currently deployed full systems.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 結果顯示前沿模型已能執行過去需專家與多年審查的密碼分析。這強化了系統性使用AI協助評估密碼標準的理由，但對目前已部署的完整系統仍無實際威脅。
items_flat.quote: These are substantial research advances, but they don’t have a practical impact on today’s systems. HAWK is a proposed scheme that hasn’t been deployed anywhere, and the AES attack we discovered was on a weaker version and does not break the full cipher.
items_flat.quote_zh: 這些是重大的研究進展，但對現今系統沒有實際影響。HAWK是尚未部署的提案方案，我們發現的AES攻擊則針對較弱版本，並未破解完整密碼。

links.label: Anthropic Research – Discovering cryptographic weaknesses with Claude

items_flat.title_en: Grok 4.5 Now Available in GitHub Copilot
items_flat.summary_en: xAI announced that Grok 4.5 is rolling out in GitHub Copilot for Pro, Pro+, Max, Business and Enterprise users. It supports up to 500k-token context, text+image inputs and adjustable reasoning effort, selectable from the model picker in VS Code and other GitHub surfaces.
items_flat.summary_zh: xAI宣布Grok 4.5已開始在GitHub Copilot上線，供Pro、Pro+、Max、Business與Enterprise用戶使用。支援最高50萬token上下文、文字+影像輸入與可調推理強度，可在VS Code及其他GitHub介面的模型選擇器中選用。
items_flat.analysis_en: The integration puts a competitively priced frontier coding model directly into the daily workflow of millions of developers, intensifying pressure on other model providers inside the Copilot ecosystem.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此整合將價格具競爭力的前沿編碼模型直接放入數百萬開發者的日常工作流程，加劇Copilot生態系內其他模型供應商的壓力。
items_flat.quote: Grok 4.5, our smartest coding model, is now available in GitHub Copilot.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們最強的編碼模型Grok 4.5現已可在GitHub Copilot中使用。

links.label: xAI Blog – Grok 4.5 in GitHub Copilot

items_flat.title_en: Elon Musk Teases Grok 4.6 (1.5T) Around August 7 and Grok 4.7 (2.1T) Weeks Later
items_flat.title_zh: Elon Musk預告Grok 4.6（1.5T）約8月7日、Grok 4.7（2.1T）數週後推出
items_flat.summary_en: In an X post, Elon Musk stated that Grok 4.6 (1.5T model with significantly improved SFT & RL) is expected around August 7, followed a few weeks later by Grok 4.7 (2.1T model that is better in every way except slightly slower to serve, with even better token efficiency).
items_flat.summary_zh: Elon Musk在X發文表示，Grok 4.6（1.5T模型，大幅改進SFT與RL）預計約8月7日推出，數週後再推出Grok 4.7（2.1T模型，各方面更優但服務稍慢、token效率更高）。
items_flat.analysis_en: The rapid cadence continues xAI’s monthly-foundation-model strategy and keeps competitive pressure on closed rivals. Exact performance gains, pricing and public availability details are still unknown.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 快速節奏延續xAI每月基礎模型策略，並持續對封閉對手施壓。實際效能提升、定價與公開時程細節仍未知。
items_flat.quote: Grok 4.6 releases around August 7. This will be the 1.5T model with significantly improved SFT & RL. Grok 4.7 will be the 2.1T model released a few weeks later. This will be better than 4.6 in every way, except slightly slower to serve, albeit with even better token efficiency.
items_flat.quote_zh: Grok 4.6約在8月7日發布。這將是1.5T模型，SFT與RL大幅改進。Grok 4.7將是2.1T模型，數週後推出。各方面都比4.6更好，只是服務稍慢，但token效率更高。

items_flat.title_en: Meta and BlackRock Announce $14B 1GW Data-Center Venture in El Paso for AI
items_flat.title_zh: Meta與貝萊德宣布140億美元、1GW艾爾帕索AI資料中心合資案
items_flat.summary_en: Meta and BlackRock announced a joint venture to develop and own a 1-gigawatt data-center campus in El Paso, Texas, with total development costs of approximately $14 billion. BlackRock funds will hold 80% ownership and Meta 20%; the facility is intended to support Meta’s AI compute needs.
items_flat.summary_zh: Meta與貝萊德宣布合資開發並擁有德州艾爾帕索一座1GW資料中心園區，總開發成本約140億美元。貝萊德基金持股80%、Meta持股20%；設施將支援Meta的AI運算需求。
items_flat.analysis_en: The deal underscores the capital intensity of frontier AI compute and Meta’s willingness to share ownership to accelerate capacity. Actual GPU deployment timelines and power-sourcing details will determine competitive impact.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此交易凸顯前沿AI運算的資本密集度，以及Meta願意透過共享所有權加速產能的策略。實際GPU部署時程與電力來源將決定競爭影響。
items_flat.quote: Funds managed by BlackRock will own an 80% interest in the venture, while Meta will retain the remaining 20% ownership.
items_flat.quote_zh: BlackRock管理的基金將持有合資事業80%權益，Meta保留剩餘20%所有權。

items_flat.title_en: Meta Signs EU AI Act Code of Practice on Transparency of AI-Generated Content
items_flat.title_zh: Meta簽署歐盟AI法「AI生成內容透明度」實務守則
items_flat.summary_en: Meta announced it is signing the EU AI Act Code of Practice on Transparency of AI-Generated Content. The move builds on Meta’s existing labeling work since 2024 and industry efforts such as C2PA, aiming for practical, interoperable identification of AI-generated material.
items_flat.summary_zh: Meta宣布簽署歐盟AI法「AI生成內容透明度」實務守則。此舉延續Meta自2024年以來的標示工作與C2PA等產業努力，目標是建立實用且可互通的AI生成內容識別機制。
items_flat.analysis_en: Signing signals proactive regulatory alignment in Europe while Meta continues to emphasize that transparency must remain usable rather than purely compliance-driven. Implementation details and cross-platform consistency will matter most.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 簽署顯示Meta在歐洲主動對齊監管，同時強調透明度必須實用而非純合規。實作細節與跨平台一致性最為關鍵。
items_flat.quote: Signing the EU AI Act Code of Practice on Transparency of AI-Generated Content... reflects our commitment to this principle.
items_flat.quote_zh: 簽署歐盟AI法《AI生成內容透明度實務守則》……反映我們對此原則的承諾。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI Releases Open-Source Codex Security CLI
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI quietly released the open-source Codex Security CLI, which lets developers scan repositories, track findings across runs, verify fixes, and add security checks to CI/CD pipelines. It is available via npm as @openai/codex-security and on GitHub; the company noted Hacker News discovered it before the official X announcement.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI靜默開源Codex Security CLI，讓開發者掃描程式庫、跨執行追蹤發現、驗證修復，並將安全檢查加入CI/CD流程。可透過npm安裝@openai/codex-security，亦有GitHub原始碼；公司表示Hacker News比官方X公告更早發現。
items_flat.analysis_en: Making the security agent’s CLI open and CI-friendly lowers the barrier for teams already using Codex-style agents to adopt continuous vulnerability scanning. Real-world false-positive rates and coverage against sophisticated multi-step attacks will determine adoption.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 將安全代理的CLI開源並支援CI，降低已使用Codex類代理的團隊導入持續弱點掃描的門檻。實際誤報率與對複雜多步驟攻擊的覆蓋度將決定採用程度。
items_flat.quote: We quietly released the open-source Codex Security CLI, but Hacker News found it before we had a chance to share it here... You can now use it to scan repositories, track findings across runs, verify fixes, and add security checks to CI/CD.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們靜默發布了開源Codex Security CLI，但Hacker News比我們有機會在這裡分享更早發現……現在你可以用它掃描程式庫、跨執行追蹤發現、驗證修復，並將安全檢查加入CI/CD。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic Brings MCP 2026-07-28 Spec (Stateless Core) to Claude
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic將MCP 2026-07-28規格（無狀態核心）導入Claude
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic announced support for the MCP 2026-07-28 specification across Claude products. The update moves MCP to a stateless request/response core, hardens authorization to align with production OAuth 2.0/OIDC, and graduates official extensions.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic宣布Claude產品全面支援MCP 2026-07-28規格。此更新將MCP改為無狀態請求/回應核心、強化授權以對齊生產級OAuth 2.0/OIDC，並正式化官方擴充。
items_flat.analysis_en: A stateless core removes a major scaling friction for MCP servers and should accelerate enterprise and edge deployments. Success will depend on how quickly the broader ecosystem of tools and hosts adopts the new specification.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 無狀態核心消除MCP伺服器的主要擴展摩擦，應能加速企業與邊緣部署。成敗取決於更廣泛的工具與主機生態系多快採用新規格。
items_flat.quote: The latest spec moves MCP to a stateless core, while hardening authorization and graduating official extensions. This simplifies the experience of building MCP servers for Claude and scaling their usage as they grow in adoption.
items_flat.quote_zh: 最新規格將MCP改為無狀態核心，同時強化授權並正式推出官方擴充。這簡化了為Claude建構MCP伺服器的體驗，並隨著使用量成長更容易擴展。

links.label: Claude Blog – Bringing MCP 2026-07-28 to Claude

meta.analysis_en: Signing signals proactive regulatory alignment in Europe while Meta continues to emphasize that transparency must remain usable rather than purely compliance-driven. Implementation details and cross-platform consistency will matter most.
meta.analysis_zh: 簽署顯示Meta在歐洲主動對齊監管，同時強調透明度必須實用而非純合規。實作細節與跨平台一致性最為關鍵。
meta.quote: Signing the EU AI Act Code of Practice on Transparency of AI-Generated Content... reflects our commitment to this principle.
meta.quote_zh: 簽署歐盟AI法《AI生成內容透明度實務守則》……反映我們對此原則的承諾。

xai.title_en: xAI Introduces Build Mode for Creating Apps, Games and Dashboards with Grok
xai.title_zh: xAI推出Build Mode，讓Grok即時打造App、遊戲與儀表板
xai.summary_en: xAI announced Build Mode, now in early beta for SuperGrok Heavy subscribers on web, iOS and Android. Users describe an idea and Grok builds a working website, app, game or interactive dashboard live in the chat, then publishes it to a shareable link.
xai.summary_zh: xAI宣布Build Mode進入早期測試，僅限SuperGrok Heavy訂閱者在網頁、iOS與Android使用。使用者描述想法後，Grok會在聊天中即時打造可運作的網站、App、遊戲或互動儀表板，並可發布成可分享連結。
xai.analysis_en: This further collapses the distance between idea and functional software inside Grok’s ecosystem. Production robustness, long-term maintainability and real multi-user scale remain to be proven.
xai.analysis_zh: 這進一步縮短從想法到可運作軟體的距離，並將整個創作循環留在Grok生態系內。實際生產穩定性、長期維護與多用戶規模仍有待驗證。
xai.quote: Today we're introducing Build Mode, a new way to create with Grok. Tell Grok an idea, and it builds a working version live in your chat... When it's ready, publish it to a link anyone can open.
xai.quote_zh: 今天我們推出Build Mode，一種用Grok創作的新方式。告訴Grok一個想法，它就會在聊天中即時打造可運作的版本……準備好後，可發布成任何人都能開啟的連結。

xai.title_en: Grok 4.5 Now Available in GitHub Copilot
xai.summary_en: xAI announced that Grok 4.5 is rolling out in GitHub Copilot for Pro, Pro+, Max, Business and Enterprise users. It supports up to 500k-token context, text+image inputs and adjustable reasoning effort, selectable from the model picker in VS Code and other GitHub surfaces.
xai.summary_zh: xAI宣布Grok 4.5已開始在GitHub Copilot上線，供Pro、Pro+、Max、Business與Enterprise用戶使用。支援最高50萬token上下文、文字+影像輸入與可調推理強度，可在VS Code及其他GitHub介面的模型選擇器中選用。
xai.analysis_en: The integration puts a competitively priced frontier coding model directly into the daily workflow of millions of developers, intensifying pressure on other model providers inside the Copilot ecosystem.
xai.analysis_zh: 此整合將價格具競爭力的前沿編碼模型直接放入數百萬開發者的日常工作流程，加劇Copilot生態系內其他模型供應商的壓力。
xai.quote: Grok 4.5, our smartest coding model, is now available in GitHub Copilot.
xai.quote_zh: 我們最強的編碼模型Grok 4.5現已可在GitHub Copilot中使用。

xai.title_en: Elon Musk Teases Grok 4.6 (1.5T) Around August 7 and Grok 4.7 (2.1T) Weeks Later
xai.title_zh: Elon Musk預告Grok 4.6（1.5T）約8月7日、Grok 4.7（2.1T）數週後推出
xai.summary_en: In an X post, Elon Musk stated that Grok 4.6 (1.5T model with significantly improved SFT & RL) is expected around August 7, followed a few weeks later by Grok 4.7 (2.1T model that is better in every way except slightly slower to serve, with even better token efficiency).
xai.summary_zh: Elon Musk在X發文表示，Grok 4.6（1.5T模型，大幅改進SFT與RL）預計約8月7日推出，數週後再推出Grok 4.7（2.1T模型，各方面更優但服務稍慢、token效率更高）。
xai.analysis_en: The rapid cadence continues xAI’s monthly-foundation-model strategy and keeps competitive pressure on closed rivals. Exact performance gains, pricing and public availability details are still unknown.
xai.analysis_zh: 快速節奏延續xAI每月基礎模型策略，並持續對封閉對手施壓。實際效能提升、定價與公開時程細節仍未知。
xai.quote: Grok 4.6 releases around August 7. This will be the 1.5T model with significantly improved SFT & RL. Grok 4.7 will be the 2.1T model released a few weeks later. This will be better than 4.6 in every way, except slightly slower to serve, albeit with even better token efficiency.
xai.quote_zh: Grok 4.6約在8月7日發布。這將是1.5T模型，SFT與RL大幅改進。Grok 4.7將是2.1T模型，數週後推出。各方面都比4.6更好，只是服務稍慢，但token效率更高。

frontier_other.title_en: Over 1,200 AI Lab Staff Petition U.S. Government to Support Tools for Deliberately Pacing Frontier AI
frontier_other.title_zh: 超過1,200名AI實驗室員工聯署請願，呼籲美國政府支持「刻意調節前沿AI」工具
frontier_other.summary_en: More than 1,200 researchers and staff from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta and other labs signed the “Pacing the Frontier” petition. It asks the U.S. government to support an international effort to develop technical and governance tools that would allow deliberately pacing the frontier of automated AI development. OpenAI and Anthropic publicly endorsed the statement.
frontier_other.summary_zh: 超過1,200名來自OpenAI、Anthropic、Google、Meta等實驗室的研究人員與員工簽署「Pacing the Frontier」請願書，呼籲美國政府支持國際合作，開發能刻意調節自動化AI發展前沿的技術與治理工具。OpenAI與Anthropic已公開表態支持。
frontier_other.analysis_en: Cross-lab consensus on optional pacing mechanisms rather than an immediate pause is rare. Whether governments build usable tools, and how competitive pressures shape any future voluntary adoption, remains the central uncertainty.
frontier_other.analysis_zh: 跨實驗室對「可選的節奏調節工具」而非立即暫停達成共識相當罕見。政府是否真正建立可用機制，以及競爭壓力如何影響未來自願採用，仍是關鍵不確定性。
frontier_other.quote: We request that the U.S. government support an international effort to develop the technical and governance tools needed to deliberately pace the frontier of automated AI development.
frontier_other.quote_zh: 我們請求美國政府支持一項國際努力，開發必要的技術與治理工具，以便刻意調節自動化AI發展的前沿。

frontier_other.title_en: NVIDIA-Led Open Secure AI Alliance Expands with 60 Partners Including xAI, Microsoft and Hugging Face
frontier_other.title_zh: NVIDIA主導的Open Secure AI聯盟擴至60家夥伴，涵蓋xAI、Microsoft與Hugging Face
frontier_other.summary_en: NVIDIA’s Open Secure AI Alliance, launched 27 July and further promoted on 28 July, brings together around 60 organizations (including SpaceXAI/xAI, Microsoft, Hugging Face, Mistral, IBM, Linux Foundation and others) to develop open tools and techniques that keep software and agents secure.
frontier_other.summary_zh: NVIDIA於7月27日啟動、28日持續推廣的Open Secure AI聯盟，已匯集約60家組織（含SpaceXAI/xAI、Microsoft、Hugging Face、Mistral、IBM、Linux Foundation等），共同開發開放工具與技術，以保障軟體與AI代理的安全。
frontier_other.analysis_en: The alliance frames open models and tooling as defensive assets after recent closed-model sandbox incidents. Long-term impact hinges on concrete shared artifacts and whether major closed-model labs eventually join.
frontier_other.analysis_zh: 聯盟將開放模型與工具定位為近期封閉模型沙箱事件後的防禦資產。長期成效取決於實際共享產出，以及主要封閉模型實驗室是否最終加入。
frontier_other.quote: NVIDIA is contributing open models, model weights, data and new agent harness research to the Open Secure AI Alliance to speed the development of new cybersecurity tools and techniques.
frontier_other.quote_zh: NVIDIA將向Open Secure AI聯盟貢獻開放模型、權重、資料與新的代理框架研究，以加速新型網路安全工具與技術的開發。

brief_en: Over 1,200 staff from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta and others petitioned for U.S.-backed tools to deliberately pace frontier AI; xAI launched Build Mode and Grok 4.5 in GitHub Copilot while teasing 4.6/4.7; Anthropic reported Claude Mythos cryptanalysis wins and MCP updates; NVIDIA grew its Open Secure AI Alliance; Meta announced a $14B El Paso data-center JV and signed the EU AI Act transparency code; OpenAI open-sourced its Codex Security CLI.
brief_zh: 超過1,200名OpenAI、Anthropic、Google、Meta等實驗室員工聯署請願，呼籲美國支持刻意調節前沿AI的工具；xAI推出Build Mode與Grok 4.5進GitHub Copilot並預告4.6/4.7；Anthropic發布Claude密碼分析成果與MCP更新；NVIDIA擴大Open Secure AI聯盟；Meta宣布140億美元艾爾帕索資料中心合資並簽署歐盟AI法透明度守則；OpenAI開源Codex Security CLI。
